## 4. Timeframe

| Aspect | Value |
|---|---|
| Base timeframe | `H4` |
| Multi-timeframe refs | see `Strategy_*` hooks in the .mq5 |
| Bar gating | Explicit `QM_IsNewBar(_Symbol, PERIOD_H4)`; `OnInit` fails closed on non-H4 charts |

Cycle quadrature uses the fixed Ehlers four-element FIR coefficients
`[0.0962, 0.5769, -0.5769, -0.0962]` at lags `[0, 2, 4, 6]`.
The unclamped phase-unwrapped period is the entry-admission value; invalid or
outside-band observations are rejected. Accepted entries encode their period
in the position/deal comment so the time stop and same-direction cooldown can
be reconstructed after restart.
